content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIELIT Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIELIT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NIELIT IT Resource Persons Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NIELIT IT Resource Persons posts is 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts available include Sr. Hardware Engineer, Sr. Programmer (various designations), and Assistant Programmer 'B'. These positions are for IT Resource Persons on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for IT Resource Persons at NIELIT?
faq.answer: The salary for IT Resource Persons ranges from Rs. 33756 to Rs. 60519 per month, depending on the specific post. Detailed salary breakdowns for each post are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for NIELIT IT Resource Persons Recruitment 2026 is online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the direct application link to submit their forms.

faq.question: Q5. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates generally need a B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Computer Science/IT/Electronics or MCA/M.Sc (Electronics/IT). Some posts also accept BCA/DOEACC IT-A Level/BSC(IT)/PGDCA qualifications.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NIELIT IT Resource Persons Recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the NIELIT IT Resource Persons Recruitment 2026. Candidates should still verify this detail in the official PDF.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The posts are for deployment in specific Government Departments, primarily in New Delhi, Delhi, with some posts also mentioning locations like Kolkata and Mumbai.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these NIELIT positions?
faq.answer: The IT Resource Persons positions advertised by NIELIT are on a contract basis. This offers an opportunity to work with government departments for a specified period.

faq.question: Q9. How can I download the official notification for NIELIT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains comprehensive details about the recruitment process, eligibility, and application instructions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the experience required for Sr. Programmer posts?
faq.answer: For Sr. Programmer posts, candidates generally require 3+ years of relevant experience. For Assistant Programmer 'B' posts, 1+ year of experience is typically required. Specifics are in the eligibility section.
